# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

Only diagnosis code is supplied; model internals cannot be verified. The adapter exposes the trained module as `view.model`, item embeddings through `view.item_emb`, sequence features through `log2feats(sequence)`, and candidate logits through `predict_score(features, items)`. Paired probes use `log2feats(sequence)[:, -1, :]` as the final user representation after zero-left-padding the history.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses public training histories and explicit dataset routes for the four required categories. The loader supplies matching B × L sequence, positive-item, and negative-item tensors. `run_full_diagnosis` temporarily switches actual modules to evaluation mode and restores module modes and global RNG states afterward. Scoring probes disable gradients.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Embedding alignment:** Samples up to 2,048 nonpadding embeddings and computes `(mean pairwise cosine + 1)/2`. Values near 1 indicate strong directional alignment; 0.5 means zero average cosine. This does not establish representation rank or recommendation diversity.
- **Positive–negative margins:** Scores sampled training pairs at valid positions. Reports count, mean, lower tenth percentile, fraction below zero, and fraction below 0.5. Larger positive margins and fewer inversions indicate better sampled-pair separation; raw score scale affects interpretation.
- **History sensitivity:** Measures target rank change, hit@10 change, top-ten overlap, and final-feature cosine. Positive rank change means worse ranking; negative hit change means lost hits. Sensitivity itself is neither inherently good nor bad.

# Perturbation & Tests

A saved deterministic manifest selects up to 32 users/category, each with a final training interaction as target and 99 unique negatives. Tests delete oldest or recent items, randomly delete items across five replicates, or shuffle earlier items while preserving the last item across five replicates. Deletions compact histories and alter positions. Repeated unchanged-history scoring checks determinism. Position-preserving controls are unsupported.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

The result contains `metrics` and `metric_definitions`. Metrics include embedding/margin summaries, nested `history_perturbations`, an unexecuted `intervention_experiment` plan, and diagnostic accounting. Perturbations retain user records, controls, coverage, per-category summaries, and four-category macro estimates with 1,000 user-bootstrap intervals.

The 2,048-sequence/30-second caps can truncate coverage and suppress macro results. Margins concern the primary view only. Targets are in-sample; intervals exclude training-seed variability and adaptive-selection bias. Item-category breakdowns are unavailable. No held-out performance, simulator traits, causal benefit, or intervention improvement is established.
